therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation and survival signaling
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with stage III-IV squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck at high-risk of recurrence after chemoradiation and surgery

results.effect_size: median DFS not reached in either arm due to insufficient events
results.dose_information: oral administration, specific dose not provided

context.duration: assessed every 3 months for first 2 years, then every 6 months for years 2-3, then annually for years 4-5
context.investigator_commentary: trial terminated early due to insufficient enrollment with only 3 patients enrolled (2 afatinib, 1 placebo)
